Venue Biography

Built into the natural contours of the Cheshire countryside, Oulton Park's stunning scenery makes it the most picturesque circuit on the British Superbike Championship calendar. It’s not just a beautiful backdrop though, the circuit is renowned as one of the most challenging in UK motorsport, and is a favourite with both spectators and competitors. The parkland setting hosts the UK’s leading motorcycle racing series twice annually, with all races on the full International circuit – revered as one of the world’s great natural tests for rider and machine.
